sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Beyond the basics, JS has four lenses:

- **Async patterns** — Promise.all / allSettled / race; cancellation via `AbortController`.
- **Iteration** — generators, async iterators, `for await`.
- **Memory** — closures retain refs; weak refs (`WeakMap` / `WeakSet`) for caches.
- **Meta-programming** — `Proxy` + `Reflect`, decorators (Stage 3).
- **Performance** — V8 hidden classes, inline caches, deopts.

sections.body:

- **Scenario-based** — applied questions tying multiple topics together. Drill these *last*, after the fundamentals are sharp.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **Promise chaining** — return the next promise, never `.then(() => promise)` then forget.
- **`AbortController`** — modern cancellation; `fetch` accepts a signal.
- **Generators** are pull, async iterators are push-pull; `for await` is the bridge.
- **WeakMap** for object-keyed caches that don't leak.
- **Don't reach for `Proxy`** unless you need transparent interception (ORM, validation).

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd model the async flow with `Promise.allSettled` for fan-out tolerance, propagate cancellation via `AbortController`, use generators for lazy pipelines, and reserve `Proxy` for transparent interception only when nothing simpler fits."*
